subject: [Escalation] OmniFin: sudden throughput regression, errors, and lane entanglement
messages:
From: Tim Bradley <tim.bradley@omnifin.com>
To: OmniFin SRE <support@omnifin.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-27T08:02:00Z
Subject: URGENT: Production latencies spiking + 502s from Redwood (region us-east-1)

Hi team,

We started seeing a major degradation at ~07:50 UTC — increased 95/99 latencies, rising 5xx rate, and total throughput for our tenant fell by roughly 60%. This is causing timeouts for customer-facing flows. Our SRE attached some traces and a short log snippet showing a cluster of 502/504s and repeated retries.

Attached: omnifin_error_snapshot-1127.log, omnifin-hol-traces-1127.txt.

Can someone confirm whether there was a config change on your side or a routing change? We’re currently paged and will escalate if this isn’t acknowledged in 15 minutes.

--
Tim Bradley
SRE Team Lead, OmniFin
Tim.Bradley@omnifin.com

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Tim Bradley <tim.bradley@omnifin.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-27T08:08:00Z
Subject: Re: URGENT: Production latencies spiking + 502s from Redwood (region us-east-1)

Thanks Tim — acknowledged. I’m pulling in Ben (serving runtime) and Laura (your account lead). We’ve seen similar symptoms in a few tenants earlier this week but not this severity.

Immediate next steps:
- Ben, can you validate whether any KV/eviction or batching config changed for OmniFin or the us-east pool in the last 60 minutes?
- Laura, want to set a 30-min bridge for customer-facing execs if we need an SLA credit decision.

I’ll keep you posted every 10 minutes.

--
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
